'''Plasmajack''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was a known treasure hunter and partner with [[Vette]], [[Taunt]], and [[Flash (Twi'lek)|Flash]]<ref name="Vette">{{HolonetOld|biographies|vette|Vette}}</ref> during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and reconstituted [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Setting">{{TORweb|url=info/story/setting|text=Game Setting|nolive=1}} on [http://www.swtor.com ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''{{'s}} official website]</ref>

==Biography==
[[Taunt]], [[Vette]], Plasmajack, and [[Flash (Twi'lek)|Flash]] formed together a gang, whose last major job together was [[Cada Bliss]], a rich [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] obsessed with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] culture. The gang stripped Bliss of almost everything valuable, but Bliss's revenge on them was hard. Mercenaries were set on their tail and Vette was captured and sold into slavery. Plasmajack and the others tracked down Bliss in return, hoping for eventual payback. By the time Vette changed hands and ended up with a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]], Bliss has acquired a Twi'lek artifact called the [[Star of Kala'unn]]. Driven by her desire to take the artifact back, Vette convinced the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to confront Cada Bliss at the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] spaceport, where she took the artifact from him. Vette later arranged a reunion with Plasmajack and the others at the spaceport and the gang had a good time together, before Vette handed the Star of Kala'unn over to them. Impressed with Vette's accomplishments for the Twi'lek pride, the gang asked her back, though Vette preferred to stay with her new Sith master.

==Behind the scenes==
Plasmajack's first mention was in the [http://swtor.com/info/holonet/biographies biography] section of [[The Holonet]], an online information database provided by the [http://swtor.com official website] of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Plasmajack was listed as an associate of Vette's on her Holonet entry.<ref name="Vette" />
